* Places 5–12 on Sunday are unnamed beyond Trandosite's twelve. ''Star Wars Insider'' #43 gives 3rd [[Lucas Hernandez]] and 4th [[Adam Ankrum]] on tie-breakers. [[John Shields]] interview gives 13th; Trandosite gives [[Evan Ferguson]] 14th and [[Philipp Jacobs]] missing the twelve.
* Sunday sealed winner (top Dark vs top Light) is not on the packet.

== Possibly faulty data ==

* Packet field is 56 finalists. Trandosite uses 55 for Ferguson's 14th.
* Trandosite spelled Ferguson as Fergusson; the packet and the wiki person page use Ferguson.
* Packet lists [[Joe Atread]]; canonical page is [[Joe Alread]] (1997 Worlds prose and Squadron Gold 79). [[Joe Atread]] redirects to [[Joe Alread]].
* Packet city for [[John Shields]] is Chitenham, Gloucestershire.
* [[Jean-Baptiste Naudet]] is listed Country UK, city Chester, qualifying event Concord Dawn Paris.

== Marginal cuts ==

* Code of Conduct rules 1–14 (opaque sleeves, raised hands after games, no writing, no stalling, no strategic forfeit, Life Force activation one card at a time). Format-relevant pieces (deck lists, Saturday-night-only changes, 60-card check, activation convention) are on [[Tournaments#1998 World Championship packet]] and the hub Format section.
* December 1998 Current Rulings sheet (Cane Adiss through Sienar Fleet Systems) is named, not dumped card-by-card.
* Arrival and departure flight numbers and airlines.

== Build notes ==

Packet is a 12-page scanned PDF from CategoryOneGames, 20 November 1998, Kendrick Summers letterhead. Alphabetized finalist list is page 8. Preserved copy of the live PDF URL is Wayback 20261008195330 (application/pdf, 683859 bytes). Phone column omitted from dest.

== Possibly faulty data ==

* [[Chuck Kallenbach]]'s 2007 post accuses [[Michael Riboulet]] of cheating in the final (lost pile / floor / miscount). That is Kallenbach's account; it is not dested as encyclopedia fact. Potter's win after a recount is dested.
* Parking-lot threat to [[Jerry Darcy]] and a thrown chair are Kallenbach-only (2007 post; Booster Pack #07). Talk only.
* Category One Games recap (2013) twice places 1998 Worlds in Florida; the packet, Insider, and Kallenbach put it at the Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach.
* Special Edition product mailed to finalists: ''Star Wars Insider'' #43 complete set; Kallenbach "a couple boxes"; Sokol complete set plus boxes; Hunter a booster box or two and starters; Booster Pack #07 "three boxes". Body keeps Insider's complete set and "mailed product".
